patch_description: Restructure the solver around an Iterated Local Search / Large Neighborhood Search architecture with three clean phases: (1) randomized greedy construction, (2) destroy-and-repair perturbation starting from the incumbent best (every few trials, remove 4–6 transactions and greedily reinsert them at their cheapest positions), and (3) simulated annealing with mixed move neighborhoods and stagnation kicks. The destroy-repair moves operate near a proven-good basin instead of rebuilding from scratch, giving cost-guided diversity that pure random restarts lack, while the modular phase structure keeps construction cheap so more improvement iterations fit in the time budget.
